title: What’s on
intro: Find free, inclusive activities and events for people of all ages in our East London community.

blocks.heading: Activities for everyone
paragraphs: Our community centre hosts activities for older people, children and young people. General opening times are 10am–4pm.

blocks.heading: LinkAge Plus
paragraphs: LinkAge Plus has five hubs across Tower Hamlets. Activities take place at partner hubs across the borough.

blocks.heading: Visit us
paragraphs: Toynbee Hall is at 28 Commercial Street, London, E1 6LS. Check individual activity details before travelling.
